blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Recent diffusion-based pipelines have achieved promising progress in image-to-3D synthesis.
However, generating high-fidelity details remains challenging, especially when the input image contains rich details.
Existing approaches often rely on globally encoded conditioning features, which compress spatial information and limit the model to reproduce fine-grained details.
This common design often leads to a phenomenon we term detail attenuation .
Moreover, improving image-to-3D synthesis quality typically requires retraining or fine-tuning large diffusion models, which can be computationally expensive and impractical for complex 3D pipelines.
In this work, we present B lended T ile C onditioning for image-to- 3D generation ( BTC3D ), a training-free inference time framework that enhances fine-grained detail preservation in image-to-3D diffusion pipelines.
To alleviate detail attenuation , we first examine the image feature additivity in image-to-3D models.
Based on this property, we introduce a blended tile embedding that extracts local conditioning signals from split image regional patches, allowing the diffusion model to better preserve fine-grained visual details.
To integrate the global and local conditioning guidance stably, we propose a dynamic conditioning schedule that gradually increases the influence of tile-level conditioning during later low-noise stages of diffusion.
Our proposed method BTC3D operates entirely at inference time and can be seamlessly integrated into existing image-to-3D diffusion pipelines.
Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach significantly improves texture quality and visual fidelity of the base model while maintaining global structural consistency in a training-free manner. Figure 1: Baselines vs. BTC3D . The image-to-3D models suffer from detail attenuation in 3D synthesis.
The details from the input conditional images are not recognized in the 3D assets.
By comparison, applying our BTC3D to TRELLIS/TRELLIS.2/Hunyuan3D-v2.1 augments the 3D assets generation by enriching such detail preservation.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Generative models for 3D asset creation have witnessed significant advancements ( Li et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2025b ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2025 ) , facilitating their widespread adoption across diverse domains, including entertainment ( Xu et al., 2024 ) , robotics ( Ke et al., 2024 ) and healthcare ( Khader et al., 2023 ) .
Recently, flow matching techniques ( Lipman et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) have been applied to image-to-3D synthesis, exemplified by TRELLIS ( Xiang et al., 2025a ; Xiang et al., 2025b ) and Hunyuan3D ( Team, 2024 ; Team, 2025a ) series.
They demonstrate strong ability to generate high-fidelity 3D objects by mapping heterogeneous representations into a unified latent space, while explicitly disentangling geometric structures from appearance attributes.
Despite their success, generating high-quality textures remains a challenging problem for image-to-3D models, which we refer to as detail attenuation .
This limitation becomes particularly evident when preserving detailed textures, as shown in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh:
3D资产创造的基因模型取得了重大进展(Li等人,2025a); Li等人,2025年b;Wu等人,2025年b;Ye等人,2025年b),促进在包括娱乐(徐等人,2024年),机器人(Ke等人,2024年b)和保健(Khader等人,2023年b)在内的不同领域广泛采用.
最近,流比技术(Lipman等人,2023年;Liu等人,2023年)被应用于图像到3D合成,例如TRELLIS(Xiang等人,2025年a); Xiang等人,2025b)和Hunyuan3D(Team,2024;Team,2025a)系列.
它们通过将不同的表示物映射到一个统一的潜伏空间,同时明确将几何结构与外观属性区分开来,显示出产生高真性立体物体的强大能力.
尽管它们取得了成功,但生成高质量的纹理对于图像到3D模型仍然是一个挑战性的问题,我们称之为细节衰减。
如图1所示,在保留详细的纹理时,这一限制特别明显。

blocks.en:
The detail attenuation results from a common design in existing pipelines ( Li et al., 2025b ; Team, 2025a ; Team, 2025b ; Xiang et al., 2025a ; Xiang et al., 2025b ) , where these 3D generative models often encode the entire input image into a single global conditioning representation.
While this representation captures coarse-grained semantic information, it inevitably compresses spatial details and reduces the model’s ability to reproduce fine-grained textures.
As a result, generated textures often appear over-smoothed or lack details.
Another limitation lies in the diffusion sampling process itself.
During the denoising stage, early timesteps mainly determine global structure, whereas generated details are formed during the late stages of sampling.
However, standard pipelines use the same conditioning representation throughout the sampling trajectory, despite the different roles of early and late generation stages.
blocks.zh:
细节的减弱是由于在现有管道中共同设计(Li等人,2025年b;Team,2025年a;Team,2025年b;Xiang等人,2025年a;Xiang等人,2025年b),在这些管道中,这些3D基因模型经常将整个输入图像编码为单一的全球调制代表.
虽然这种表示方式捕捉粗糙的语义信息,但不可避免地会压缩空间细节,降低模型复制细纹纹素的能力.
因此,生成的纹理往往显得过于沉闷或缺乏细节.
另一个局限在于扩散取样过程本身。
在点名阶段,早期时间步骤主要决定全球结构,而生成的细节则在采样的后期形成.
然而,标准管道在整个采样轨迹中都使用相同的调节表示,尽管早期和晚生成阶段的作用不同.

blocks.en: To address detail attenuation , we investigate whether generation quality can be improved at inference time without modifying model parameters. Our key insight is that global and local image conditioning serve different roles during the coarse-to-fine generation process: global conditioning is important for overall structure during the early generation steps, while local conditioning provides fine-grained cues that become more useful as generation progresses toward detail synthesis. Combining global and local conditioning is enabled by an empirical property we identify in image-to-3D models: image feature additivity . Specifically, we find that combining feature-level representations of local image patches produces semantically aligned 3D outputs, preserving spatially localized details that global conditioning alone tends to suppress. This property is consistent with observations in 2D image models ( Girdhar et al., 2023 ; Qin et al., 2025 ) and language models ( Hu et al., 2024b ; Mikolov et al., 2013 ) , but has not been explored in the context of 3D generation.
blocks.zh: 为了解决细节衰减问题,我们调查是否能够在推论时改进生成质量而不修改模型参数。 我们的关键见解是,全球和局部图像调节在粗细到精细的生成过程中起到不同的作用:全球调节对于早期生成阶段的整体结构很重要,而局部调节则提供了精细的刻度提示,随着生成过程向细节合成发展,这些提示变得更加有用。 结合全球和局部的调制是通过我们在图像到3D模型中识别的经验属性实现的:图像特征的相加性。 具体地说,我们发现,结合局部图像补丁的地物级表示,会产生精密匹配的立体输出,保留空间局部性的细节,仅全球条件就倾向于压制这些细节。 这种属性与2D图像模型(Girdhar等人,2023年;秦等人,2025年)和语言模型(Hu等人,2024年b;Mikolov等人,2013年)中的观测一致,但还没有在3D生成的背景下进行探索.

blocks.en: Motivated by this finding, we introduce B lended T ile C onditioning ( BTC3D ), which extracts localized conditioning features from image patches and aggregates them via a foreground-based weighting scheme into a Blended Tile Conditioning Embedding ( BTCemb ). This embedding complements the global conditioning signal, providing the model with fine-grained local cues that improve detail preservation. To integrate these two levels of conditioning stably, we further propose a dynamic conditioning ( DyCond ) mechanism that progressively increases the influence of BTCemb during the later diffusion stage, where fine details are formed, while maintaining global structural consistency.
blocks.zh: 基于这一发现,我们引入了B出借的T ile C onditioning(BTC3D),它从图像补丁中提取本地化的调理功能,并通过基于前景的加权法将其聚合到混合调理条件嵌入(BTCemb)中. 这种嵌入补充了全球调制信号,为模型提供了精细的局部提示,改善了细节保存. 为了稳定地整合这两个层次的调制,我们进一步提出了动态调制(DyCond)机制,在后期的传播阶段逐渐增加BTCemb的影响力,在扩散阶段形成细细的细节,同时保持全球结构的一致性.

blocks.en:
To verify the effectiveness of our method BTC3D , we evaluate existing image-to-3D models against our training-free framework on the public 3D-Arena ( Ebert, 2025 ) and Toys4K ( Stojanov et al., 2021 ) benchmarks.
From both quantitative and qualitative experimental results, BTC3D demonstrates improvements while applied to existing image-to-3D pipelines without retraining. To summarize, our contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh:
为了验证我们的方法BTC3D的有效性,我们参照我们关于公共3D-Arena(Ebert,2025年)和Toys4K(Stojanov等人,2021年)基准的无培训框架,评估现有的图像到3D模型。
从定量和定性实验结果来看,BTC3D显示出改进,同时适用于现有的图像到3D管道而不进行再培训。 概括而言,我们的贡献如下:

blocks.en:
• We identify the detail attenuation problem in existing image-to-3D models. To alleviate the detail attenuation problem, we are the first to reveal the image feature additivity property in image-to-3D models, which is the underlying mechanism of our training-free framework. • We introduce a training-free mechanism named blended tile conditioning ( BTC3D ), which extracts localized conditioning feature BTCemb from regional image patches.
It is further refined by exploiting the low-noise regime for 3D texture enhancement.
We thus design a dynamic conditioning schedule that progressively integrates local guidance during diffusion, improving visual fidelity while maintaining structural consistency. • Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that BTC3D achieves state-of-the-art performance in image-to-3D generation. Moreover, it can be seamlessly integrated into existing diffusion-based image-to-3D pipelines without retraining.

通过利用低噪声系统增强3D纹理,进一步加以完善。
因此,我们设计了动态调节时间表,在传播过程中逐步结合局部指导,提高视觉忠心度,同时保持结构一致性. · 对多个基准的广泛试验表明,BTC3D在图像到3D生成中实现了最先进的性能. 此外,它可以无缝地融入现有的基于扩散的图像到3D管道,而无需再培训。

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: Two dominant paradigms have been established for high-quality image-to-3D generation. The first one lifts 2D diffusion models to 3D by optimization-based distillation and the second one, named native 3D generation paradigm, enables precise geometry synthesis by explicit geometric representation modeling and learned 3D feature extraction.
blocks.zh: 已经为高质量图像到3D的生成建立了两个主导范式. 第一种通过基于优化的蒸馏将2D扩散模型提升到3D,第二种则命名为原生3D生成范式,通过显式几何表达模型和学习3D特征提取,可以进行精确几何合成.

blocks.en:
3D Generation via 2D priors. The first prevalent branch focuses on distilling useful priors from pretrained 2D generative models ( Podell et al., 2024 ; Ramesh et al., 2022 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ) into feed-forward 3D reconstruction algorithms, which can be divided into data-based and gradient-based distillation strategies.
Data distillation fine-tunes 2D models to synthesize multi-view images ( Shi et al., 2024 ; Shriram et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) , which are further reconstructed into 3D assets via techniques such as 3D Gaussian splatting ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) .
Gradient distillation, typified by Score Distillation Sampling introduced by the pivotal work DreamFusion ( Poole et al., 2023 ) , directly guides 3D optimization through gradient signals from 2D diffusion models. This technique was followed by numerous successors ( Tang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) .
Despite their effectiveness, distillation-based approaches lack an explicit latent 3D space, which severely limits fine-grained structural control over the generated assets.
They especially struggle at keeping multi-view consistency and the precise alignment of texture with fine-grained geometric details.
These problems could hardly be avoided as they are deeply rooted in the inherent limitations of the distillation pipeline itself, unless one can generate textures directly and natively within 3D space.
blocks.zh:
3D 生成通过 2D 前身 。 第一个流行分支侧重于从预先训练的2D基因模型(Podell等人,2024年;Ramesh等人,2022年;Rombach等人,2022年)中分馏有用的前科,成为饲料向前的3D重建算法,可以分为基于数据的分馏策略和基于梯度的分馏策略.
数据衍射微调2D模型以合成多视图图像(Shi等人,2024年;Shriram等人,2025年;Yu等人,2025年),这些模型通过3D Gaussian浮雕等技术进一步重建为3D资产(Kerbl等人,2023年).
渐变蒸馏,由枢轴工作DreamFusion(Poole等人,2023年)引入的Score Distillation Sampling 典型,通过2D扩散模型的梯度信号直接引导3D优化. 这一技术被众多的继任者所沿用(唐等人,2024;王等人,2025;王等人,2023).
以蒸馏为基础的办法尽管有效,但缺乏明确的潜在立体空间,严重限制了对所生成资产的精细结构控制。
他们尤其努力保持多视图一致性,精确地将纹理与精细的几何细节对齐.
这些问题很难避免,因为它们深深地植根于蒸馏管道本身固有的局限性,除非人们能够在三维空间内直接和本土产生纹理。

blocks.en:
Native 3D Generation. To overcome the above limitations, the second paradigm pursues unified native 3D generative models trained from scratch.
Inspired by the remarkable success of diffusion models in 2D image and video synthesis ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Khachatryan et al., 2023 ) , recent methods ( Cheng et al., 2023 ; Ren et al., 2024 ; Zeng et al., 2022 ; Zeng et al., 2024 ) learn compact latent representations and perform generation within this compressed latent space, significantly advancing 3D generative modeling.
Benefiting from large-scale 3D datasets ( Deitke et al., 2023a ; Deitke et al., 2023b ) , modern 3D foundation models ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025b ; Team, 2025b ) have been developed to capture strong geometric priors, enabling not only high-quality generation across diverse object categories but also various downstream applications such as shape analysis ( Du et al., 2025 ) and 3D editing ( Hu et al., 2024a ; Li et al., 2026 ) .
Notably, image-to-3D synthesis currently achieves substantially higher fidelity and controllability than text-to-3D synthesis.
However, most existing native 3D generators are restricted to either explicit representations (e.g., point clouds, voxels, meshes) or implicit formulations (e.g., neural fields, 3D Gaussians).
TRELLIS ( Xiang et al., 2025b ) addresses this constraint by introducing a Structured Latent Representation (SLAT) that supports flexible multi-format 3D generation, whose versatility we inherit to accommodate diverse 3D modalities in our framework.
Although these 3D foundation models exhibit strong generalization abilities, they mainly generate samples from a learned data distribution and lack dedicated mechanisms for user-specified personalization or example-driven control.
In this paper, we leverage the powerful priors encoded in the 3D foundation models and introduce a training-free refinement framework.
blocks.zh:
原生3D世代. 为了克服上述限制,第二个范式追求从零开始训练的统一本地3D基因模型.
受到2D影像和视频合成中传播模型的显著成功(Ho等人,2020年;Khachatriyan等人,2023年),近代方法(Cheng等人,2023年;Ren等人,2024年;Zeng等人,2022年;Zeng等人,2024年)的启发,在此压缩潜伏空间内学习紧凑的潜伏表示并进行生成,显著推进了3D基因模型.
利用大型立体数据集(Deitke等人,2023年a;Deitke等人,2023年b),现代立体基础模型(Chen等人,2025年;Hong等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年b;Team,2025年b)的开发,可以捕捉到强几何前兆,不仅能够跨不同对象类别进行高质量的生成,而且能够实现形状分析(Du等人,2025年)和3D编辑(Hu等人,2024年a;Li等人,2026年)等各种下游应用.
值得注意的是,图像到-3D的合成目前比文本到-3D的合成实现的忠实性和可控性要高得多.
然而,大多数现存的原生3D生成器被限制在明示的表示(如点云,伏牛,meshes)或隐含的配体(如神经场,3D高斯人).
TRELLIS(Xiang等人,2025年b)解决了这一制约因素,采用了一种结构式的Latet代表(SLAT),支持灵活的多格式3D生成,我们继承了这种多功能,以适应我们框架内的各种3D模式.
虽然这些3D基础模型显示出强大的通俗化能力,但它们主要从一个学习过的数据分布中生成样本,缺乏用户指定个性化或实例驱动控制的专门机制.
在本文中,我们利用3D基础模型中编码的强大前科,引入了免训练的完善框架.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
To address the detail attenuation problem in image-to-3D generations, we propose a training-free, inference-time framework, named Blended Tile Conditioning for image-to-3D generation ( BTC3D ). BTC3D builds on the key insight that global conditioning is more important early in generation, while local conditioning becomes more useful for fine details at later stages.
In Section 3.1 , we demonstrate the empirical basis of our method, the compositionality and compatibility of image features in generation.
Based on these observed properties, we then build our approach in Section 3.2 and illustrate it in Figure 3 .
blocks.zh:
为了解决图像到3D世代中的细节衰减问题,我们提出一个无训练,推论时间框架,命名为图像到3D世代的BTC3D组合(BTC3D). BTC3D基于关键的见解,即全球调制在生成初期更为重要,而本地调制则在后期的细微细节上变得更加有用.
在第3.1节中,我们展示了我们方法的经验基础、图像特性在生成中的构成性和兼容性。
根据这些观察到的特性,我们将我们的方法纳入第3.2节,并在图3中加以说明。

blocks.en: 3.1 Empirical Observations on DINO-encoded Features
blocks.zh: 3.1 关于DINO编码特征的经验观察

blocks.en:
Task Definition. Image-to-3D generation aims to recover a complete 3D representation from a single input image.
Given an image I I , the goal is to produce a 3D model G G that is consistent with the visible content while inferring geometry and appearance for the occluded or unobserved regions.
Recent image-to-3D generation pipelines ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Team, 2025b ; Xiang et al., 2025b ) commonly rely on DINO-based visual encoders ( Caron et al., 2021 ; Oquab et al., 2023 ; Siméoni et al., 2025 ) to extract image conditions for 3D asset generation, which potentially compress spatial details and lead to detail attenuation .
Therefore, we propose a feature-enhanced method by blending global and local features for 3D asset generation.
blocks.zh:
任务定义。 图像到3D生成旨在从单一输入图像中恢复完整的3D表示.
鉴于图像I,目标是生成一个与可见内容一致的3D型GG,同时推断被渗透或未观测区域几何和外观。
近期的图像到3D生成管道(Chen等人,2025年;Team,2025年b;Xiang等人,2025年b)通常依靠基于DINO的视觉编码器(Caron等人,2021年;Oquab等人,2023年;Siméoni等人,2025年)来提取3D资产生成的图像条件,这有可能压缩空间细节,导致细节减弱.
因此,我们提出一种加强特性的方法,将全球和地方特性结合起来,用于三维资产生成。

blocks.en:
Specifically, existing image-to-3D models ( Team, 2025b ; Xiang et al., 2025a ; Xiang et al., 2025b ) can be roughly separated into two stages: the shape generation stage and the texture generation stage.
The first shape stage mainly deals with the structural shape and geometry generations, while the second texture stage generates textures for the shape from the first stage.
Our observed detail attenuation problem mainly occurs during the texture generation phase.
Below, we present two observations on TRELLIS.2 that reveal the compositionality and compatibility of DINOv3-encoded features, while these findings are generalizable to other 3D generation models.
blocks.zh:
具体而言,现有的图像到3D模型(Team,2025b;Xiang等人,2025a;Xiang等人,2025b)可以大致分为两个阶段:形状生成阶段和纹理生成阶段.
第一个形状阶段主要处理结构形状和几何几代,而第二个纹理阶段则从第一阶段产生形状的纹理.
我们观察到的细节衰减问题主要发生在纹理生成阶段.
下面,我们对TRELLIS.2提出两个观察,揭示了DINOv3-编码特性的构成性和兼容性,而这些发现则泛指其他3D生成模型.

blocks.en:
Figure 2: Two key observations underpin BTC3D .
(a) Compositionality: Global embedding and the average tile embedding tend to cluster in the feature space. Here, the same color denotes the same input image but with global embeddings or average tile embeddings .
(b) Compatibility: Average tile embeddings improve fine-grained detail preservation for image-to-3D generation, yet it introduces minor defects in global structural consistency. For instance, the base structure of the generated hammer fails to maintain the regular square shape observed in the baseline output.
blocks.zh:
图2:支持BTC3D的两个主要观察。
(a) 构成性:全球嵌入和平均瓦片嵌入往往在特征空间中组合。 这里,相同的颜色表示相同的输入图像,但带有全局嵌入或平均瓦片嵌入.
(b) 兼容性: 平均瓦片嵌入改进了图像到3D生成的精细细节保存,然而却引入了全球结构一致性的小缺陷. 例如,生成的锤子的基结构未能保持基线输出中观察到的正方形.

blocks.en:
Observation 1: Compositionality of embeddings in the feature space. We first investigate whether global image representations can be decomposed into local components.
Specifically, we apply t-SNE to visualize two types of embeddings: the global embedding obtained by directly encoding the input image, the average tile embedding derived by encoding divided image tiles individually and averaging them.
As shown in Figure 2 , these embeddings tend to cluster closely together in the feature space, suggesting a form of compositionality in the latent space.
blocks.zh:
意 见 1: 嵌入特征空间的构成性. 我们首先调查全球图像表达是否可分解成本地组件。
具体地说,我们应用t-SNE可视化两种嵌入方式:通过直接编码输入图像而获得的全局嵌入,通过编码分割的图像瓦片而获得的平均瓦片嵌入,并对其进行平均.
如图2所示,这些嵌入物往往在特征空间中紧密地组合在一起,表明潜在空间中的某种构成性。

blocks.en:
Observation 2: Compatibility of embeddings for image-to-3D generation. We further examine whether local feature representations can directly replace global conditioning in image-to-3D generation.
Specifically, we input the average tile embedding , derived from image tiles to the image-to-3D model for replacing the original global image embeddings.
As shown in Figure 2 , this blended embedding can be directly used for image-to-3D generation, improving fine-grained details while preserving the rough structure.
This suggests that local embeddings can be consumed by the pretrained generator and improves some local details, but direct replacement may disturb global structure.
blocks.zh:
意 见 2:图像到3D生成的嵌入兼容性. 我们进一步审查,在图像到3D生成中,本地特性表述是否能够直接取代全球条件。
具体地说,我们输入平均瓦片嵌入,从图像瓦片中推导出到图像到3D模型,以取代最初的全球图像嵌入.
如图2所示,这种混合嵌入可以直接用于图像到3D生成,在保留粗糙结构的同时,改进了细纹细节.
这表明局部嵌入物可以被经过预先训练的生成器消耗,并改进了一些局部细节,但直接替换可能会扰乱全球结构.

blocks.en:
To summarize, these observations reveal an image feature additivity property in the DINO image encoder: global representations can be decomposed into local components (compositionality), and these components can be directly utilized for generation (compatibility).
We leverage this inherent property to preserve and enhance high-fidelity details during image-to-3D generation.
blocks.zh:
概括地说,这些观测揭示了DINO图像编码器中一个图像特征的附加属性:全局表示可以分解为局部组件(compositionality),这些组件可以直接用于生成(兼容性).
我们利用这种固有财产来保存和加强图像到3D生成过程中的高可靠性细节。

blocks.en: 3.2 BTC3D : Blended Tile Conditioning for Image-to-3D Generation
blocks.zh: 3.2 BTC3D: 图像至-3D的混合衬垫条件 生成

blocks.en:
Method Overview. Our proposed BTC3D consists of two components:
(1) Blended Tile Conditioning Embedding ( BTCemb ), which extracts local embeddings from overlapping image tiles and aggregates them as local conditions for feature optimization;
and (2) Dynamic Conditioning ( DyCond ), which progressively integrates local conditioning as generation moves from global structure toward fine-grained details. BTC3D works during the texture generation stage of the image-to-3D models to enhance the detail preservation.
The overall pipeline is illustrated in Figure 3 .
blocks.zh:
方法概论. 我们提议的BTC3D由两个部分组成:
(1) BTCembedding(BTCemb),它从重叠的图像瓦片中提取本地嵌入,并将其聚合为特性优化的本地条件;
和(2)动态条件(DyCond),随着一代从全球结构转向精细细节,它逐渐融合了局部条件. BTC3D在图像到3D模型的纹理生成阶段工作,以加强细节保存.
整个管道如图3所示。

blocks.en: Figure 3: The overall pipeline of BTC3D , which is composed of: (a) the blended tile conditioning embedding ( BTCemb ) divides the input image into patches to enhance the feature representation; and (b) the dynamic conditioning ( DyCond ) mechanism dynamically blends global and local features aligning with the coarse-to-fine generation, addressing the detail attenuation problem.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation Setups
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价设置

blocks.en:
Evaluation Datasets. We evaluate BTC3D on 3D-Arena ( Ebert, 2025 ) and Toys4K ( Stojanov et al., 2021 ) . 3D-Arena is a public image-to-3D benchmark with diverse object-centric prompts and reference assets, providing a standardized testbed for comparing representative image-to-3D generation methods under a unified protocol. Toys4K is a 3D object dataset with the largest number of object categories currently available.
More details about benchmarks are provided in Section B.1
blocks.zh:
评价数据集。 我们评价3D-Arena(Ebert,2025年)和Toys4K(Stojanov等人,2021年)的BTC3D. 3D-Arena是一个公共图像到-3D的基准,具有多种以对象为中心的提示和参考资产,为在统一的协议下比较代表性图像到-3D生成方法提供了一个标准化的测试台. 玩具4K是一个三维对象数据集,目前可用的对象类别数量最多.
关于基准的更多详情见B.1节。

blocks.en:
Comparison Methods. We compare BTC3D with representative image-to-3D baselines, including Hi3DGen ( Ye et al., 2025 ) , TripoSG ( Li et al., 2025b ) , 3DTopia-XL ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , Hunyuan3D-2.1 ( Team, 2025b ) , TRELLIS ( Xiang et al., 2025b ) , and TRELLIS.2 ( Xiang et al., 2025a ) .
Note that the Hi3DGen and TripoSG are geometry generation methods while the others work on both geometry and texture.
For fair evaluation, all generated 3D assets are rendered into multi-view images at a fixed resolution of 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 using the same rendering protocol, which preserves high-fidelity visual details while avoiding resolution-related evaluation bias.
blocks.zh:
比较方法。 我们比较了BTC3D与代表性图像到3D基线,包括Hi3DGen(Ye等人,2025年),TripoSG(Li等人,2025年b),3DTopia-XL(Chen等人,2025年),Hunyuan3D-2.1(Team,2025年b),TRELLIS(Xiang等人,2025年b)和TRELLIS2(Xiang等人,2025年a).
注意,Hi3DGen和TripoSG是几何生成方法,而其他则同时致力于几何和纹理.
为了公平的评价,所有生成的3D资产在1024×1024 1024\times 1024的固定分辨率下被转换成多视图图像,使用相同的渲染协议,这保存了高真实性的视觉细节,同时避免了与分辨率相关的评价偏差.

blocks.en:
Implementation Details. For the image-to-3D models, we select TRELLIS, TRELLIS.2 and Hunyuan3D-2.1 as the backbones to validate the effectiveness of BTC3D across different DINO encoders and diverse 3D latent representation forms.
Following previous papers ( Xiang et al., 2025a ; Xiang et al., 2025b ; Team, 2025b ) , we use RemBG library to remove the background for condition images.
For hyperparameters, we set β = 2 , α = 0.4 \beta=2,\alpha=0.4 and N = 3 N=3 to achieve the best trade-offs.
All experiments are conducted on an NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU.
blocks.zh:
执行详情。 对于图像到3D模型,我们选择TRELLIS,TRELLIS.2和Hunyuan3D-2.1作为主干,以验证BTC3D在不同DINO编码器和不同3D潜在代表表上的效能.
继之前的论文(Xiang等人,2025a;Xiang等人,2025b;Team,2025b)之后,我们使用RemBG库去除条件图像的背景.
对于超参数,我们设定β=2,α=0.4\β=2,α=0.4和N=3N=3,以实现最佳的权衡.
所有实验都是在NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU上进行的.

blocks.en: Evaluation Metrics. We evaluate generated 3D assets using complementary metrics. CLIP-I ( Radford et al., 2021 ) and LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) measure semantic alignment and perceptual similarity between the input image and rendered views, respectively. PSNR and SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) provide auxiliary assessments of pixel-level fidelity and local structural similarity. ULIP-2 ( Xue et al., 2024 ) and Uni3D ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) assess image-to-asset alignment using native 3D representations.

blocks.en: 4.2 Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 实验结果

blocks.en:
Quantitative Results. Table 1 reports the quantitative comparison on the 3D-Arena and Toys4K benchmarks.
Visual alignment is measured with CLIP-I, perceptual appearance similarity is additionally assessed with LPIPS, pixel-level fidelity and local structural similarity are evaluated with PSNR and SSIM, respectively, and multimodal 3D foundation models including ULIP-2 and Uni3D are employed to evaluate image-to-asset alignment from a 3D-aware representation perspective.
The results show that our method achieves improvements across all metrics over baselines including the TRELLIS family and Hunyuan3D-2.1. In particular, our gains are more pronounced on native 3D metrics such as ULIP-2 and Uni3D. We also achieve improvements over the baselines on detail-related metrics, including PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS.

结果显示,我们的方法在基线方面,包括TRELLIS家族和Hunyuan3D-2.1的所有指标都得到了改进。 特别是,在本地立体测量,如ULIP-2和Uni3D方面,我们的进展更为明显。 我们还在详细度量基准方面有所改进,包括PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS。

blocks.en:
Qualitative Results. Visual comparisons of our 3D generation quality are presented in Figure 5 . We exclude TripoSG and Hi3DGen from this comparison, as these methods primarily focus on geometric generation. To demonstrate the effectiveness of BTC3D , we apply it to three leading open-source image-to-3D models: TRELLIS, TRELLIS.2 and Hunyuan3D-2.1.
While these backbones can generate visually plausible global geometry from reference inputs, conditioning on a single full-image encoding may not fully account for fine-grained local details. In the illustrated examples, some outputs exhibit smoother surface textures and less distinct local patterns or material cues than those in the input images, reflecting a degree of detail attenuation . By incorporating complementary local features, BTC3D improves the preservation of these appearance details while maintaining coherent global structure, serving as a plug-and-play enhancement to the backbone models.
blocks.zh:
定性结果. 我们3D生成质量的可视比较见图5。 我们把TripoSG和Hi3DGen排除在这一比较之外,因为这些方法主要侧重于几何生成。 为了证明BTC3D的有效性,我们将它应用于三种主要的开源图像到3D模型: TRELIS,TRELIS.2和湖南省3D-2.
虽然这些主干能从参考输入中产生视觉上可行的全球几何学,但以单一全图像编码为条件可能无法充分说明精细的本地细节。 在图例中,一些产出显示出比输入图像中更平滑的表面纹理和不太不同的局部图案或材料提示,反映出某种程度的减退。 BTC3D通过纳入互补的局部特性,改进了这些外观细节的保存,同时保持了连贯的全球结构,起到对骨干模型的插件和游戏增强的作用.

blocks.en:
We further compare the semantic consistency of different generated assets with respect to the input images.
Compared with other methods, the outputs enhanced by BTC3D better preserve object identity, category-level semantics, and input-specific visual cues.
Although TripoSG and Hi3DGen can produce reasonable geometric structures, their outputs are primarily shape-oriented and lack faithful surface appearance.
Similarly, 3DTopia-XL often captures the coarse object shape but loses fine local correspondences between the generated asset and the input image.
By comparison, BTC3D maintains semantic alignment while recovering fine-grained textures, sharp material boundaries, and realistic surface appearances.
We also note that existing methods ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Team, 2025b ) generally achieve high-fidelity image-to-3D generation through large-scale training regimens. In contrast, BTC3D enables the restoration of fine-grained visual detail and texture fidelity directly from pre-trained off-the-shelf 3D generation models in a completely training-free manner.

我们进一步比较不同生成的资产与输入图像的语义一致性。
与其他方法相比,BTC3D增强的输出能更好地保存对象身份,分类层次的语义,以及输入特定视觉提示.
虽然TripoSG和Hi3DGen可以产生合理的几何结构,但其输出主要面向形状,缺乏忠实的表面外观.

As shown in Section 4.3 and Figure 6 , equipping the TRELLIS.2 baseline with BTCemb yields consistent performance gains on both ULIP-2 and Uni3D metrics. This indicates that our foreground-based tile weighting delivers more expressive local cues than vanilla global conditioning alone. Further integrating DyCond upon BTCemb brings additional performance improvements, demonstrating that progressively injecting tile-level conditioning in the low-noise generation stage is more effective than static conditioning. Combining both modules achieves the best overall results, which verifies the complementary effect of our proposed modules.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we present a training-free refinement framework, named B lended T ile C onditioning for Image-to- 3D synthesis ( BTC3D ).
Our approach BTC3D starts from our observation about the image feature additivity in image-to-3D generative models. Based on such property, we introduce the blended tile-conditioned embedding ( BTCemb ) that extracts local conditioning signals from divided image patches, allowing the diffusion model to better preserve fine-grained visual details.
To stabilize the integration of global and local guidance, we propose a dynamic conditioning ( DyCond ) schedule that gradually increases the influence of tile-level conditioning during later low-noise diffusion regimes, such an operation further enhances the texture quality.
Our method BTC3D operates entirely at inference time and can be seamlessly integrated into diverse image-to-3D diffusion pipelines. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach improves texture sharpness and visual fidelity while maintaining global structural consistency.

我们的方法 BTC3D 始于我们对图像特性在图像到3D基因模型中的相加性的观察. 基于这种属性,我们引入了混合瓦片条件嵌入(BTCemb),从分裂的图像补丁中提取局部的调节信号,使扩散模型能够更好地保存精细的视觉细节.
为了稳定全球和地方指导的整合,我们提出动态调节(DyCond)时间表,在后来的低噪音扩散系统中逐渐增加瓦片级调节的影响,这种操作进一步提高了纹理质量.
我们的方法BTC3D完全在推论时间运行,可以无缝地集成到多样化的图像到3D扩散管道中. 实验结果表明,拟议办法在保持全球结构一致性的同时,提高了纹理的锐度和视觉的忠诚度。

blocks.en:
Limitations. While BTC3D mitigates detail attenuation and enhances fine-grained texture fidelity for image-to-3D generation, several limitations remain.
The framework is validated primarily on flow-matching-based native 3D diffusion pipelines (e.g., the TRELLIS family), and its applicability to other 3D generation paradigms remains to be evaluated.
Moreover, BTC3D primarily targets texture enhancement, and its current implementation uses DINO-series encoders; adaptation to other visual encoders may require re-tuning.
blocks.zh:
限制。 虽然BTC3D减轻了细节的衰减,并提高了图像到3D生成的精细纹理的忠诚度,但仍有一些局限性.
该框架主要通过基于流匹配的本地3D传播管道(如TRELLIS家族)进行验证,其对其他3D生成范式的适用性仍有待评估.
此外,BTC3D主要针对纹理增强,其目前的实施使用DINO系列编码器;适应其他视觉编码器可能需要重新调整.

blocks.en:
Broader Impacts. Our proposed BTC3D delivers substantial positive broader impacts by boosting the quality and practicality of image-to-3D generation.
It lowers the technical barrier and production cost for creating high-fidelity textured 3D assets, supporting diverse applications such as game development, film and television virtual production, industrial design, cultural heritage digitization, robotics, and metaverse content creation, benefiting both professional creators and non-expert users.
On the other hand, the strong detail-preserving capability may enable unauthorized duplication, counterfeiting, or misuse of copyrighted objects, branded products, or real-world artifacts, raising intellectual property and ethical concerns.
To address such risks, responsible deployment, content authentication mechanisms, and clear usage norms are needed to ensure the technology benefits society while reducing potential harms.

blocks.en: Appendix B Implementation and Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 执行和评价详情

blocks.en:
To validate the applicability of our method BTC3D to existing image-to-3D models, we adopt TRELLIS ( Xiang et al., 2025b ) , TRELLIS.2 ( Xiang et al., 2025a ) and Hunyuan3D-2.1 ( Team, 2025b ) as our backbone models, which allows us to evaluate the performance of BTC3D when applied to different configurations of the DINO model and diverse 3D latent representations.
Note that TRELLIS and Hunyuan3D-2.1 employ DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2023 ) as its image encoder, while TRELLIS.2 adopts DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) for image encoding.
These encoders are characterized by distinct 3D latent representations for 3D asset modeling.
Evaluations conducted on these three backbones to demonstrate the generalizability of BTC3D across diverse scenarios.
Below, we include the implementation and evaluation details of our methods and comparison methods.
blocks.zh:
为了验证我们的方法BTC3D适用于现有的图像到3D模型,我们采用TRELLIS(Xiang等人,2025b),TRELLIS2(Xiang等人,2025a)和Hunyuan3D-2.1(Team,2025b)作为我们的骨干模型,这使我们能够在应用到DINO模型的不同配置和多样的3D潜在表示时评价BTC3D的性能.
注意TRELLIS和Hunyuan3D-2.1采用DINOv2(Oquab等人,2023年)作为其图像编码器,而TRELLIS2则采用DINOv3(Siméoni等人,2025年)作为图像编码器.
这些编码器的特点是,3D资产模型化具有明显的3D潜在表示.
对这三个主干进行了评价,以显示BTC3D在各种不同情况下的通用性。
下面我们包括我们的方法和比较方法的执行和评价细节。

blocks.en: B.1 Evaluation Datasets
blocks.zh: B.1 评价数据集

blocks.en:
We evaluate BTC3D on two public evaluation datasets: 3D-Arena ( Ebert, 2025 ) and Toys4K ( Stojanov et al., 2021 ) .
3D-Arena is a public benchmark for image-to-3D generation, containing diverse object-centric reference images and providing a standardized testbed for comparing representative image-to-3D methods under a unified evaluation protocol.
We evaluate all compared methods on the complete 3D-Arena evaluation set without sample-level filtering or post-hoc exclusion. All aggregate results are recomputed over the same complete set.
blocks.zh:
我们对两个公共评价数据集进行BTC3D评价: 3D-Arena(Ebert,2025年)和玩具4K (Stojanov等人,2021年).
3D-Arena是图像到3D生成的公共基准,包含多样的以对象为中心的参考图像,并提供一个标准化的测试台,用于在统一的评价协议下比较具有代表性的图像到3D方法.
我们评价所有比较方法 在完整的 3D-Arena 评估集 上,没有样本级的过滤 或后热排除。 所有汇总结果都在同一整套结果中重新计算。

blocks.en:
Toys4K is a category-diverse 3D object dataset containing 4,179 objects across 105 categories.
We construct a category-balanced evaluation subset by randomly sampling two distinct objects without replacement from each category, yielding 210 objects in total.
The sampling is performed once using a fixed random seed of 2026, and the resulting sample manifest is fixed before generation and shared across all compared methods.
blocks.zh:
Toys4K是一个类别分散的3D对象数据集,包含跨越105个类别的4,179个对象.
我们通过随机抽取两个不同的物体而不从每个类别中替换来构建一个类别平衡的评价子集,总共产生210个物体.
采样一次使用2026年的固定随机种子进行,产生的样品表在生成前固定,并在所有比较方法中共享.

blocks.en:
By conducting evaluations on both datasets, we assess BTC3D performance under two distinct settings: two general public benchmarks, 3D-Arena benchmark and Toys4K benchmark.
For fair comparison, all quantitative evaluations are conducted on the common subset for which precomputed results from all compared methods are available.
blocks.zh:
通过对两个数据集进行评价,我们在两个不同的环境下评估BTC3D的表现:两个一般公共基准,3D-Arena基准和Toys4K基准.
为了进行公平的比较,所有定量评价都是针对所有比较方法的预估结果的共同子集进行的。

blocks.en: B.2 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: B.2 评价计量

blocks.en:
We adopt a comprehensive set of metrics to evaluate the generated 3D assets from complementary perspectives.
This section describes all metrics reported in the main table and the full appendix tables.
The main comparison focuses on CLIP-I ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) , PSNR, SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , ULIP-2 ( Xue et al., 2024 ) , and Uni3D ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) , covering rendered-view alignment, perceptual similarity, pixel-level fidelity, local structural similarity, and 3D-aware image-to-asset alignment.

blocks.en: Detailed textures and sharp boundaries often involve high-frequency image components, making sensitivity to such components relevant to local detail preservation. To complement the generation results, we compare the frequency responses of Global and BTCemb to examine how local tile encoding affects the representation of high-frequency information.
blocks.zh: 详细的纹理和尖锐的界限往往涉及高频图像组件,使这些组件对本地细节保存具有敏感性. 为了补充生成结果,我们比较了Global和BTCemb的频率响应,以审查局部的瓦片编码如何影响高频信息的表示.

blocks.en: To examine sensitivity to high-frequency details at the encoding stage, we probe the frozen DINOv3 encoder ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) using controlled 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 full-field sinusoidal gratings. Stimuli are generated in linear luminance with a background level of 0.25 0.25 and Michelson contrast of 0.25 0.25 , using a raised-cosine taper over the outer 8 % 8\% of each image dimension, and then converted to sRGB while retaining float32 precision. The displayed frequencies are 4 , 8 , 16 , 24 , 32 , 48 , 64 , 96 , 128 , 160 , 192 , 256 , 320 , 384 , 4,8,16,24,32,48,64,96,128,160,192,256,320,384, and 448 448 cycles/image. At each frequency, we evaluate four orientations θ ∈ { 0 ∘ , 45 ∘ , 90 ∘ , 135 ∘ } \theta\in\{0^{\circ},45^{\circ},90^{\circ},135^{\circ}\} and two phases ϕ ∈ { 0 , π / 2 } \phi\in\{0,\pi/2\} .

Global uses the complete conditioning tensor obtained by encoding the full image. For BTCemb , tiles are resized to the encoder input resolution, encoded independently, and combined through weighted aggregation of their complete conditioning tensors. The tile extraction and aggregation settings remain fixed throughout the experiment.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 7 , Global responds more strongly at the lower sampled frequencies, whereas BTCemb maintains stronger responses toward the high-frequency end, particularly at 256 256 – 448 448 cycles/image. This suggests that tiled encoding and aggregation help preserve sensitivity to fine spatial variations that are less distinguishable under global encoding. Since each tile is resized to the encoder input resolution, this behavior reflects the combined effects of the local field of view, rescaling, and feature aggregation. These results provide encoder-level evidence complementary to the region-level and rendered-image evaluations, rather than a direct measurement of generated texture fidelity.

blocks.en: C.4 Additional Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: C.4 其他量化结果

blocks.en:
Table 8 reports the supplementary evaluation results on 3D-Arena and Toys4K.
These metrics complement the main comparison by measuring normal-map alignment with CLIP-N, distribution-level fidelity with CLIP-FID, rendered-view feature consistency with DINO, perceptual similarity with LPIPS (Best view), and rendered detail responses with Edge Density and Laplacian Variance.
blocks.zh:
表8报告了3D-Arena和Toys4K的补充评价结果。
这些指标通过测量与CLIP-N的正常图配比、与CLIP-FID的分布级忠诚度、与DINO的渲染特性一致性、与LPIPS的感知相似性(最佳视图)以及同Edge Density和Laplacian差异的详细反应来补充主要比较。

blocks.en:
Overall, BTC3D shows consistent benefits on several supplementary diagnostics across different backbones.
On 3D-Arena, applying BTC3D to TRELLIS and TRELLIS.2 improves distribution-level fidelity and rendered-view feature consistency, as reflected by lower CLIP-FID and higher DINO scores.
It also improves several perceptual and detail-related indicators, including LPIPS (Best view) and Laplacian Variance for TRELLIS-family backbones.
For Hunyuan3D-2.1, BTC3D also improves CLIP-FID and DINO, suggesting that the proposed refinement is not limited to TRELLIS-family models but can also serve as a plug-and-play method for other strong image-to-3D backbones.
blocks.zh:
总体而言,BTC3D显示不同骨干上的若干补充诊断具有一致的效益.
在3D-Arena上,将BTC3D应用到TRELLIS和TRELLIS 2上,提高了分布级的忠诚度和渲染景色特征一致性,表现为CLIP-FID较低和DINO分数较高.
它还改进了若干与概念和细节有关的指标,包括LPIPS(最佳视图)和TRELLIS-家庭主干线的拉普拉西亚差异。
对于Hunyuan3D-2.1,BTC3D也改进了CLIP-FID和DINO,表示拟议的改进并不限于TRELLIS-家族模型,也可以作为其他强成影像到3D主干件的插座和游戏方法.

blocks.en:
On Toys4K dataset, the advantages of BTC3D are more evident on texture-sensitive diagnostics.
For Hunyuan3D-2.1, BTC3D improves CLIP-FID, DINO, LPIPS (Best view), and Edge Density, indicating better rendered appearance fidelity and richer local detail responses.
For TRELLIS and TRELLIS.2, BTC3D also improves multiple supplementary metrics, especially DINO, LPIPS (Best view), Edge Density, and Laplacian Variance.
blocks.zh:
在Toys4K数据集上,BTC3D的优点在纹理敏感诊断上更为明显.
对于Hunyuan3D-2.1,BTC3D改进了CLIP-FID,DINO,LPIPS(最佳视图)和Edge Density,表明更能使外表保持忠实,更丰富本地的详细反应.

The high Laplacian Variance of 3DTopia-XL on Toys4K is mainly driven by sharp silhouettes, hard geometric boundaries, and artifact-like edges, rather than faithful texture recovery.
Thus, Edge Density and Laplacian Variance are used only as auxiliary rendered-detail diagnostics.

blocks.en: C.6 User Study
blocks.zh: C.6 用户研究

blocks.en:
As noted in B.2 , automatic evaluation metrics such as CLIP-I and ULIP-2 primarily measure global semantic alignment and may not fully capture fine-grained texture fidelity, local geometry coherence, or human-perceived visual quality.
To complement the automated quantitative results in C.4 and further validate BTC3D for detail-preserving image-to-3D generation, we conduct a pairwise human preference study comparing 3D assets generated by the baseline TRELLIS.2 and its variant integrated with BTC3D on 3D-Arena ( Ebert, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
如B.2所述,CLIP-I和ULIP-2等自动评价指标主要衡量全球语义一致,可能不能完全捕捉到精细纹理的忠贞,局部几何一致性,或人类感知的视觉质量.
为了补充C.4中的自动定量结果,并进一步验证BTC3D用于细节保存图像到3D生成,我们进行了双向人类偏好研究,比较基线TRELLIS.2产生的3D资产及其在3D-Arena上与BTC3D结合的变体(Ebert, 2025).

blocks.en:
Stimuli Preparation. We use all 101 samples from the 3D-Arena dataset to construct the stimulus pool for the user study.
For each sample, we pair the GLB assets generated by the baseline TRELLIS.2 and by TRELLIS.2 integrated with BTC3D .
Both assets are loaded directly into interactive 3D viewers and displayed side by side, with the conditioning input image positioned above them as a visual reference.
Within each pair, the assets are centered and displayed using a shared scale, identical lighting and background conditions, and matched initial camera settings.
Participants can freely rotate, zoom, and pan the models to inspect their geometry and appearance, with synchronized camera controls available to facilitate comparison.
Each participant evaluates 20 distinct pairs randomly sampled from the full 101-sample pool.
blocks.zh:
刺激准备. 我们利用3D-Arena数据集的所有101个样本来构建用于用户研究的刺激池.
对于每个样本,我们对基线TRELLIS.2和与BTC3D结合的TRELLIS.2生成的GLB资产进行配对.
两种资产直接装入交互式3D查看器并并肩显示,其上方的调制输入图像定位为视觉参考.
每对内,资产以共享的尺度、相同的照明和背景条件以及匹配的初始相机设置为中心和显示。
参与者可以自由旋转,缩放,并填充模型以检查其几何和外观,同时提供同步相机控制以方便比较.
每个参与者从完整的101样本池中随机抽取20对不同的对子.

blocks.en:
Evaluation Protocol. The user study involved 20 participants and adopts a two-alternative forced-choice (2AFC) pairwise comparison protocol ( Qiu et al., 2024 ; Liu and others, 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2018 ) . Each participant evaluates 20 distinct samples randomly drawn without replacement from the full pool of 101 3D-Arena samples, with the presentation order randomized for each participant.
For each sample, the conditioning input image is displayed above two interactive 3D viewers labeled A and B, without revealing the corresponding generation methods. Participants can rotate, zoom, and pan the models, with synchronized camera controls available to facilitate comparison. The assignment of the baseline and BTC3D outputs to A and B is randomized for each sample within each participant’s session using a session-specific random seed, to mitigate positional bias.
Participants answer the question: “Which 3D asset is better?” by selecting either “A is better” or “B is better.” They are instructed to choose the asset that better matches the reference image, considering its shape, appearance, and visual details. Responses are recorded through a custom web-based interface. The interface uses a responsive layout to support both desktop and mobile devices, while retaining the same reference image, paired interactive 3D viewers, and response options.

blocks.en: Appendix E Discussion and Future Works
blocks.zh: 附录E 讨论和未来工程

blocks.en: E.1 Discussion
blocks.zh: E.1 讨论情况

blocks.en:
Evaluating image-to-3D generation remains challenging because its evaluation protocol fundamentally differs from that of conventional 3D reconstruction.
3D reconstruction typically assumes posed input images and follows strict multi-view geometric constraints, where evaluation mainly focuses on how well the reconstructed scene matches the observed views or ground-truth geometry under known camera poses.
By contrast, image-to-3D generation does not require input camera poses and aims to produce a complete 3D asset from a single image, including plausible geometry, texture, and even material for both visible and unseen regions.
Since the generated 3D asset is not guaranteed to be view-aligned with the input image or any predefined ground-truth coordinate frame, the same input image may correspond to multiple plausible 3D assets with different geometry, object scale, canonical orientation, and unseen-region appearance.
Therefore, conventional reconstruction metrics, such as PSNR, SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , Chamfer Distance, F-score, and LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) on matched-view renderings, measure agreement with a reference under a specific evaluation protocol. Their interpretation should account for alignment conditions and the possibility of multiple plausible 3D outputs, and they should be considered alongside semantic alignment metrics for a comprehensive assessment of image-to-3D generation quality.
blocks.zh:
图像到3D生成的评价仍然具有挑战性,因为其评价协议与传统的3D重建协议有着根本的不同。
3D重建一般假设是投影投影,并遵循严格的多视图几何限制,评价主要侧重于重建的场景如何与已知相机下观测到的视角或地面真实几何相匹配.
相比之下,图像到3D的生成并不需要输入相机的外观,目的是从单一的图像中产生完整的3D资产,包括可能的几何,纹理,甚至对于可见和看不见的区域都有材料.
由于生成的3D资产无法保证与输入图像或任何预定义的地面真实坐标框架相匹配,因此相同的输入图像可能与多个可能存在的3D资产对应,这些资产具有不同的几何,对象尺度,犬形方向,以及看不见的区域外观.
因此,常规的重建度量衡,如PSNR,SSIM(Wang等人,2004年),Chamfer District,F-score,以及LPIPS(Zhang等人,2018年)在配对视图渲染上,测量协议与特定评价协议下的参考. 它们的解释应考虑到配对条件和多种可能的三维产出的可能性,并应考虑它们与语义配对指标并列,以便全面评估图像到三维生成质量。

blocks.en:
Following current image-to-3D generation evaluation metrics, we adopt commonly used metrics from recent works such as TRELLIS ( Xiang et al., 2025a ; Xiang et al., 2025b ) , Hunyuan3D ( Team, 2025a ; Team, 2025b ) , and related image-to-3D methods ( Feng et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ; Ye et al., 2025 ) .
Existing evaluation metrics can be broadly grouped into two categories:
blocks.zh:
按照目前的图像到-3D生成评价指标,我们采用了最近一些著作,如TRELLIS(Xiang等人,2025a); Xiang等人,2025b),Hunyuan3D (Team, 2025a;Team, 2025b),以及相关的图像对3D方法(Feng等人, 2025;Li等人, 2025a;Ye等人, 2025).
现有评价衡量标准可大致分为两类:

blocks.en:
The first category evaluates generated assets through rendered 2D views.
In this setting, a 3D asset is rendered into multiple images, and the rendered views are compared with the input image using image-space or feature-space metrics such as CLIP-I ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , DINO ( Caron et al., 2021 ) , LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) , or FID-style distances, as reported in Table 8 .
These metrics directly reflect the visible appearance of the asset, including texture, color, and rendered visual details.
However, they are sensitive to rendering viewpoints, lighting, image resolution, background, and the mismatch between single-view conditioning and multi-view evaluation.
blocks.zh:
第一类通过提供2D视图评价生成的资产。
在此设定中,3D资产被渲染成多个图像,所渲染的视图与使用图像空间或特征空间度量的输入图像进行比较,如CLIP-I(拉德福德等人,2021年),DINO(Caron等人,2021年),LPIPS(张等人,2018年),或FID风格的距离,如表8所示.
这些衡量标准直接反映了资产可见的外观,包括纹理,颜色,并提供了视觉细节.
然而,它们对于渲染观点,照明,图像分辨率,背景,以及单视图条件和多视图评价之间的不匹配十分敏感.

blocks.en:
The second category evaluates generated assets from a more 3D-aware representation perspective.
Following recent image-to-3D evaluation protocols, a common practice is to convert the mesh into a colored point cloud and compute image-to-point-cloud similarity using multimodal 3D foundation models such as ULIP-2 ( Xue et al., 2024 ) and Uni3D ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) .
These metrics provide useful image-to-asset alignment signals and are better suited for object-level semantic and structural consistency than purely rendered-view metrics.
However, they remain primarily alignment-oriented.
Recent 3D generation benchmarks show that 3D asset quality involves multiple dimensions, including geometry details, texture quality, geometry-texture coherence, and prompt-asset alignment ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
Therefore, global image-to-point-cloud similarity may overlook fine-grained aspects of texture-focused 3D generation, such as texture fidelity, material boundaries, and surface details.
blocks.zh:
第二类从更了解3D代表性的角度评价产生的资产。
遵循最近的图像到-3D评价协议,一个常见的做法是将网格转换成色点云,并利用ULIP-2(薛等人,2024年)和Uni3D(周等人,2024年)等多式联运3D基础模型计算图像到点云的相似性.
这些度量衡提供了有用的图像到资产对齐信号,比纯渲染度度度量衡更适合对象级语义和结构一致性.
然而,它们仍然主要面向调整。
近期3D生成基准显示,3D资产质量涉及多个维度,包括几何细节,纹理质量,几何-纹理一致性,以及快速资产对齐(Zhang等人,2025年).
因此,全球图像至点云的相似性可能会忽略纹理聚焦的3D生成的细微的方面,如纹理忠贞性,物质界限,以及表面细节.

blocks.en:
Overall, these two types of metrics provide complementary but incomplete views of image-to-3D generation quality.
In our evaluation, we therefore combine rendered-view metrics with 3D-aware image-to-point-cloud similarity metrics, and use them together to assess different aspects of 3D generation quality, as shown in Table 8 .
3DGen-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) evaluates 3D assets from multiple aspects, including geometry detail, texture quality, geometry coherence, and text–asset consistency. This shows that a single global alignment score is not enough to fully measure 3D generation quality.
blocks.zh:
总体而言,这两类衡量标准提供了图像到3D生成质量的互补但不完整的观点.
因此,在我们的评价中,我们把渲染视图的度量衡与3D-意识图像对点-云的相似度度量结合起来,并用它们来评估3D生成质量的不同方面,如表8所示。
3DGen-Bench(张等,2025年)从多个方面评价3D资产,包括几何细节,纹理质量,几何一致性,以及文本-资产一致性. 这表明,一个单一的全球比分不足以充分衡量3D生成质量.

blocks.en:
Automatic metrics and human preference studies should therefore be viewed as complementary rather than interchangeable: the former enables scalable and reproducible comparisons across methods, while the latter captures perceptual quality, local texture realism, geometry-texture consistency, and human-sensitive detail fidelity.
Accordingly, our evaluation combines automatic metrics with a user study to provide both quantitative and perceptual evidence for the effectiveness of BTC3D .
blocks.zh:
因此,自动计量法和人类偏好研究应被视为互补的而不是可互换的:前者可以使方法的可伸缩性和可再生产性进行比较,后者则能够捕捉到知觉质量、局部纹理现实主义、几何纹理一致性以及人性敏感的细节忠诚性。
因此,我们的评价将自动衡量标准与用户研究结合起来,为BTC3D的有效性提供定量和认知证据。

blocks.zh: E.2 今后的工作

blocks.en: This work opens up several promising directions for future research.
blocks.zh: 这项工作为今后的研究开辟了若干有希望的方向。

blocks.en:
First, it would be valuable to further explore the broader role of DINO-based visual representations in image-to-3D generation.
Beyond serving as conditioning signals, DINO features may provide useful cues for local correspondence, semantic part awareness, texture placement, and geometry–texture alignment, since they encode both high-level object semantics and spatially localized appearance information.
A deeper understanding of how these features support different stages of 3D generation could inspire more effective local guidance mechanisms and improve the controllability of fine-grained asset generation.
blocks.zh:
首先,进一步探讨基于DINO的视觉表现在图像到3D生成中的更广泛作用将是有价值的。
除了作为调制信号之外,DINO特性还可以为本地通信、语义部分意识、纹理定位和几何-纹理对齐提供有用的提示,因为它们既编码高级物体语义,又编码空间定位的外观信息。
更深入地了解这些特性如何支持三维生成的不同阶段,可以激励更有效的地方指导机制,提高精细成品资产生成的可控性.

blocks.en:
Second, future work may explore more comprehensive evaluation metrics for image-to-3D generation.
Current automated metrics provide useful and reproducible signals for measuring image-to-asset alignment, while human studies offer complementary insight into perceptual quality, texture realism, and geometry–texture consistency.
Developing more detail-sensitive benchmarks, standardized rendering settings, and native 3D evaluation metrics that better reflect human visual perception would further support the evaluation of high-fidelity 3D assets.
blocks.zh:
其次,今后的工作可以探索更全面的图像到3D生成评价指标。
目前的自动化度量衡为测量图像到资产对齐提供了有用和可复制的信号,而人类研究则提供了对知觉质量、纹理现实主义和几何-纹理一致性的补充见解。
制定更详细、更敏感的基准、标准化的渲染环境以及更好地反映人类视觉感知的本地3D评价衡量标准,将进一步支持对高可靠性3D资产的评价。

blocks.en:
Finally, DINO-based representations may also be useful beyond the specific image-to-3D setting studied in this work.
The combination of global and tiled visual features could potentially benefit related tasks that require both holistic semantic understanding and fine-grained local fidelity, such as texture generation, 3D asset editing, image-conditioned refinement, and multi-view content generation.
Exploring these applications may further reveal the general utility of DINO features for controllable and detail-preserving 3D content creation.
blocks.zh:
最后,基于DINO的表示方法在本文所研究的具体图像到3D设置之外也可能有用。
全球和瓷砖视觉特征的结合可能有利于相关任务,这些任务既需要整体的语义理解,也需要精细的局部忠诚,如纹理生成、3D资产编辑、图像条件改进和多视图内容生成。
探索这些应用可能会进一步揭示DINO特性对于可控和细节保存的3D内容创建的一般用途.

We present BTC3D in a modular form.
Algorithm 1 constructs the foreground-weighted tile embedding.
Algorithm 2 computes the timestep-dependent conditioning feature.
Algorithm 3 integrates both components into the sampling process of a pretrained flow-based generator.

算法 3 将两个组件都整合到一个预先训练的流基生成器的采样过程中.
